scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @repo/shared" "npm run dev -w @repo/api" "npm run dev -w @repo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @repo/shared && npm run build -w @repo/api && npm run build -w @repo/web
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
